title: New Wardrobe? Join This Clothing Swap Event In The Hudson Valley - NewsBreak
text:
By Allison ,
11 hours ago
There’s an exciting event that we can attend in the Hudson Valley this month. I’ve always heard about clothing swap gathering but I never attend them. This is our chance!
Where Is This Clothing Swap Event In The Hudson Valley?
This clothing swap event is a fun way to get some new clothes, swap items and more. I love the idea of this because it also allows us to meet new people and see what we can do at this Hudson Valley business.
Join Society of Lash in Newburgh, NY on September 27, 2025 from 4pm-6pm. Gently used clothes along with accessories are the items we can bring to this event.
Society of Lash takes pride in being,
“ The Hudson Valley’s first dedicated eyelash extension studio”
They have several locations throughout the Hudson Valley and also offer microblading, facials, spray tanning and more.
What’s The Fee To Attend This Clothing Swap Party In Newburgh, NY?
If you are swapping your clothes you would pay $10 to get in. It’s $20 for those who plan to only shop from the items. One of the best parts about this unique event include your entry fee also gets you a $20 Society of Lash gift card!
What Can Swappers, Shoppers Do In The Newburgh, NY Area After This Event?
After the clothing swap event, be sure to plan your night out in the Newburgh, NY area.
Billy Joe’s offers a full food and drink menu along with beautiful, outdoor views of the Hudson River. Hudson Taco is also another popular location where you can enjoy dinner and drinks with a view as well.
Newburgh Brewing Company offers a relaxed atmosphere where you can sip on their beer along with grabbing some food too.
I love taking in the sights of the Hudson River in the Newburgh, NY area. There’s also historical sites to visit as well. Send this to your friends, family and co-workers to join you during this fun event in the Hudson Valley.
More information about this event can be found on Eventbrite.
What event are you looking forward to attending in the Hudson Valley? Would you go to this clothing swap party? Tell us more below.
Society of Lash
12 Front Street Newburgh, NY 12550
6 Popular Grocery Store Items You Didn't Know Were Made In New York State From downstate New York to the upstate area of New York State, freshly made items are created and sold in our favorite grocery stores.
Some start in Southampton, NY while others begin in Binghamton, NY bringing a unique taste of their own. Gallery Credit: Allison Kay Canva, Facebook, Ithaca Hummus Ithaca Hummus This is one of my favorite hummus brands that I recently discovered. I was excited to learn that this hummus is from Ithaca, NY but where is it made?
refridgeratedfrozenfood.com shared information from Ithaca Hummus's founder, Chris Herby. He shared that he first started selling this hummus out of the back of his car at markets in the area.
"Those humble beginnings led to the creation of a cold-crafted hummus brand found in over 8,200 stores like Whole Foods, Publix, Target, Sprouts and more."
He also shared that all of Ithaca Hummus products are produced in upstate New York and can also be bought in New York State. Canva, Philadelphia Cream Cheese, Facebook Philadelphia Cream Cheese This grocery store favorite item was not made in Philadelphia. Instead, Philadelphia Cream Cheese is made in upstate New York.
Lancaster Farming explained that the name of this cream cheese came from the milk, milk products, quality of these items and how they were available in Philadelphia.
Did you know that cream cheese was invented in the 1870's in Chester, NY by William Lawrence who was a dairy farmer?
Price Chopper shared, "Fast forward to the present day and cream cheese is still celebrated in neighborhoods in our region."
One of America's favorite cream cheese brands is made in Lowville, NY and can be bought in stores in New York State. Canva, Facebook, Tate's Bake Shop Tate's Bake Shop These cookies are one of the most delicious store bought ones that I have purchased. I enjoy buying from businesses located in New York State and this brand makes their goodies from Southampton, NY.
Tate's Bake Shop has vegan and gluten free cookies that taste delicious! The founder of Tate's Bake Shop, Kathleeen King started baking at a young age where she would sell cookies in Long Island, NY. It's been a major success ever since.
Tate's Bake Shop shared
"Tate’s Bake Shop in Southampton, NY has been Voted the Best Bakery in the Hamptons year over year, and is a destination for locals and tourists alike. "
Be sure to visit their bakeshop in New York State. Canva, Facebook, Adirondack Beverages Adirondack Beverages When I would drink Adirondack Beverages, I didn't think about how the drink I was consuming was made in the same state that I reside in.
Adirondack Beverages share that they are located in Mohawk Valley in Scotia, NY.
They also explained that their beverages are, "Sourced from a local protected glacial aquifer this world-class water is the not-so-secret-secret ingredient."
When was the last time that you sipped on this New York State drink? Canva, Adams Fairacre Farm Crowley Did you know about Crowley's historical background in the Hudson Valley?
Crowley explained in the early 1900's, J.K Crowley purchased a dairy business right in Poughkeepsie, NY and that is when they founded the business.
In 1915, J.K Crowley then moved the business to another place within New York State. Binghamton, NY soon became the home to Crowley and its products which are still produced there today.
Will you continue to support this New York State business and buy Crowley products? Canva, Facebook, FAGE FAGE This popular yogurt brand can be found in several grocery stores within New York State. They first started off in the 1920's in a small dairy shop which was located in Athens, Greece.
In the 1990's, FAGE products made their way to America from Greece, Italy.
In the 2000's, FAGE explained that they are a "Third generation of our family begins making FAGE in beautiful upstate New York. America rejoices!" 5 Popular TV Shows That Give A Shoutout To The Hudson Valley Whether it’s around an entire episode or a quick mention, it’s always exciting to hear the Hudson Valley get called out on TV. Some of our favorite actors have shown their love for the Hudson Valley on our feel good, comfort shows. Gallery Credit: Allison Kay Getty Images, Frederick M. Brown The King of Queens, Poughkeepsie In The King of Queens episode China Syndrome, the Hudson Valley gets mentioned.
This is in Season 9 and episodes 12 and 13. Doug includes Poughkeepsie, NY by making a sarcastic remark about its smell.
Also in a King of Queens episode, another Hudson Valley town was highlighted. During the episode of Home Cheapo, Doug mentions a popular location in Orange and Rockland County, NY. This is in Season 9 and episode 7.
Doug gives a shout out to Bear Mountain and how he wants to see his friends pull him up there. Getty Images, Amy Sussman Seinfeld, Wurtsboro Seinfeld’s episode, The Glasses mentioned a Sullivan County, NY town.
Jerry's friend George loses his glasses at his local health club. He's explaining a story from the past to Jerry where he mentions Wurtsboro, NY.
"I was squinting! Remember that drive from Wurtsboro?"
In this part of the episode, George talks about the drive from Wurtsboro, NY. Getty Images, Robert Mora Friends, Poughkeepsie In an episode of Friends, The One With the Girl From Poughkeepsie, another Hudson Valley city is mentioned. This was in Season 4, episode 10.
In Friends , Ross meets a woman from Poughkeepsie and Chandler questions how much fun she can be since she's from that area. Ross pursues the woman from Poughkeepsie and takes a train there to see her.
However, Ross falls asleep on the train and wakes up to meet another woman instead. Getty Images, Alberto E. Rodriguez The Facts of Life, Peekskill In the Out of Peekskill episode from The Facts of Life, a Hudson Valley area gets a shout out. Mrs. Garrett mentions Peekskill, NY in the fall.
This Westchester County, NY area gets compared to Africa and also Cortland, NY. Even though Peekskill and Cortland are located within New York state, they are about 3 hours away from one another. Getty Images, Jamie McCarthy Jersey Shore, Poughkeepsie Snooki from the popular TV show, Jersey Shore is from the Hudson Valley area. During this reality show, she mentions how she's from the Poughkeepsie area, calling herself a "princess" to this city.
There have been times that other members of Jersey Shore have tried to embarrass her because she's from this Dutchess County, NY area.
At one time, Snooki also had a store in the Beacon, NY area. 3
